title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
description: While Harry Potter spends the summer with the Dursleys, Dobby, a house-elf, attempts to prevent him returning to Hogwarts by sabotaging an important dinner with Vernon Dursley's boss. Vernon attempts to prevent his departure in retaliation, but his friend Ron Weasley and his brothers Fred and George rescue him in their father's flying car. Harry meets up with Hermione Granger in Diagon Alley, where they meet Hogwarts' new Defence Against the Dark Arts teacher, Gilderoy Lockhart, along with Draco Malfoy and his father, Lucius, who Harry sees slip a book into Ginny Weasley's cauldron.
